# Concurrency and Transactional Consistency Checklist: Vender tokens de un jugador (SPEC-011)

**Purpose**: Evaluar la calidad de los requisitos y del diseño sobre concurrencia, atomicidad, reservas y orden de bloqueos de SPEC-011. Verifica que las garantías estén enunciadas con precisión, que sean verificables y que no se afirme más de lo que el diseño sostiene.
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [research.md](../research.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are concurrency requirements stated for every operation that mutates state, or is at least documented which operations have no concurrency requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, §FR-033]
- [x] CHK002 - Is the requirement that a publication reserves without transferring ownership stated explicitly, so that reservation and transfer are never conflated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK003 - Are atomicity requirements defined for the whole set of effects of a purchase, listing each effect that must succeed together rather than referring generally to atomicity? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK004 - Is the requirement that every rejection leaves reservations, balances, holdings and listing states untouched stated as an obligation covering both publication and purchase? [Completeness, Spec §FR-033]
- [x] CHK005 - Is documented what happens to the listing when a purchase fails after some internal step has already been executed, as a requirement and not only as an outcome? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, §FR-021]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 - Is the global lock order stated as a requirement in the specification or in a design artifact that the specification references, so that it is enforceable and auditable? [Clarity, research.md R-01]
- [x] CHK007 - Is the rule that each operation acquires a subset respecting the relative order stated with precision, without terms that are mathematically false about prefixes or contiguous ranges? [Clarity, research.md R-01]
- [x] CHK008 - Is the difference between data read without a lock and data revalidated under a lock stated explicitly, including which read does not authorise anything? [Clarity, plan.md §flujo de compra]
- [x] CHK009 - Is "efectivamente vigente" defined as a condition combining state and expiry, so that it can be evaluated at a given instant? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the level of isolation on which the requirements rely documented, or is its absence an explicit assumption? [Clarity, Gap; data-model.md]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the term "serializa" used with a defined meaning in each place it appears, rather than as an informal indication that operations queue? [Clarity, plan.md]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK012 - Is the lock order stated in the research artifact identical to the one applied by each flow of the plan, without an artifact describing an order the implementation flow does not follow? [Consistency, research.md R-01; plan.md]
- [x] CHK013 - Does the design of the publication flow avoid locking resources that it does not need, consistently with the stated rationale that publication moves no credits? [Consistency, research.md R-01, R-02; plan.md]
- [x] CHK014 - Is the guarantee that a publication is liquidated at most once stated identically in the requirements and in the contract, with the same code for the losing operation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020; contracts/buy-listing.md]
- [x] CHK015 - Is the reservation derived consistently between the requirement that defines the availability and the query that computes it, including the condition that excludes expired publications? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006; data-model.md §suma de reservas]
- [x] CHK016 - Are the effects of a cancelled or expired publication on the computed reservation stated identically in the specification and in the design? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §FR-025; research.md R-02]

## Guarantees and Residual Risk

- [x] CHK017 - Is the scope of the deadlock-avoidance guarantee bounded, stating which operations it covers and which locks it does not cover? [Gap, research.md R-01]
- [x] CHK018 - Are the locks taken outside the global order identified and justified, rather than omitted because they are implicit? [Completeness, plan.md §flujo de compra]
- [x] CHK019 - Is the known limitation of conservative rejection under concurrency documented as an accepted consequence with its user-visible effect? [Assumption, research.md R-02]
- [x] CHK020 - Is the contention risk inherited from serialising on the seller's resources identified and recorded, without presenting it as resolved? [Gap, plan.md §Performance Goals]
- [x] CHK021 - Is documented that the design does not claim a general proof of deadlock absence, and what evidence would be required for such a claim? [Traceability, research.md R-01]
- [x] CHK022 - Is the limit of what concurrency verification can demonstrate stated, so that the evidence plan does not overstate what a test proves? [Traceability, plan.md §estrategia de pruebas]

## Atomicity and Reversal

- [x] CHK023 - Are reversal requirements defined for the failure of each individual effect of a purchase, including the failure to record the transaction? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK024 - Is the requirement that a failed purchase leaves no financial record stated explicitly, given that the record is inserted in the same transaction? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK025 - Are non-negativity requirements stated for balances and holdings after every operation, not only after a successful purchase? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, §SC-009]
- [x] CHK026 - Is the requirement that the conserved totals of tokens per player and of credits between parties is documented as an invariant of the feature, with the operations that must preserve it identified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015; SC-008]
- [x] CHK027 - Is documented that reservation release is a consequence of the state changing rather than a write to a reservation field, so that release cannot fail independently? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025; research.md R-02]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK028 - Are requirements defined for two simultaneous publications of the same seller that together exceed the free holding? [Coverage, Spec §AC13]
- [x] CHK029 - Are requirements defined for two simultaneous buyers of the same publication, including the state expected after the loser is rejected? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020, §AC23]
- [x] CHK030 - Are requirements defined for a purchase and a cancellation of the same publication acting simultaneously? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK031 - Are requirements defined for a publication reaching its expiry while a purchase is in progress? [Gap, Spec §FR-010; Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK032 - Are requirements defined for the seller losing tokens by another route between publication and purchase, distinguishing that case from the ordinary flow? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK033 - Are requirements defined for a player losing visibility while a purchase of one of its publications is in progress, and is the outcome declared as a limitation rather than left open? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Measurability

- [x] CHK034 - Can each concurrency guarantee be evaluated with a stated observation, or is it expressed only as an intention? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §SC-007]
- [x] CHK035 - Is the expected outcome of a lost race specified in terms of observable state, not merely in terms of the returned code? [Measurability, Spec §AC23]
- [x] CHK036 - Is the requirement that reservations never exceed the holding expressed with the quantities involved, so that a violated case can be identified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §AC13]
- [x] CHK037 - Are the invariants that must hold after every operation listed in one place, so that verification does not have to reconstruct them? [Traceability, Gap; Spec §SC-008, §SC-009]

## Dependencies and Migration

- [x] CHK038 - Is the requirement that new migrations follow the timestamp convention stated where the schema change is defined? [Dependency, research.md R-05; data-model.md]
- [x] CHK039 - Is documented that existing migrations are not modified, and that the new column is added without changing existing constraints or indices? [Dependency, data-model.md]
- [x] CHK040 - Is the deletion semantics of the new foreign keys specified as a requirement, and is their interaction with the existing audit relationships documented? [Dependency, data-model.md; research.md R-08]
- [x] CHK041 - Are the invariants that the database must enforce declared in the design identified as such, distinguishing them from the ones enforced only by the application? [Traceability, data-model.md]
